Risk-off morning. Nasdaq futures are -1.2% and the Nikkei fell 4.9% overnight, led by chip stocks. The market light is still GREEN (VIX 17.5), but semis are getting hit. 11 trading days left.
SELL: CRWD hit its 8% stop yesterday ($250.99) and is at about $249 premarket. Sell all 5 CDRs at the open. This is the priority today.
BUY: AMD (#2) is down about 6% from Tuesday, at about $571. The plan says 1.45 sh, limit $573.67, stop $525. With chips falling overseas, I'd buy half (about 0.7 sh) at the limit and add the rest only once it stabilizes.
SNOW (held): +1.5%, ranked #18 (rank warning). Expect it to go at Monday's review. Selling today is reasonable too.
The new top 5 are DELL, AMD, MU, MRVL and ALAB, all AI hardware. That concentration is why the system's simulated account (-7.9%) is getting hit.
You -0.9%, S&P -0.2%. Staying mostly in cash has protected you this week.
